items.title: Ford reopens Canada auto plant, defying Trump tariffs
items.summary: Ford on Friday reopened a Canadian auto plant following a $3.5 billion retooling project, defying President Donald Trump's efforts to force auto companies to make vehicles stateside.The plant in Oakville, Ontario, west of Toronto, was upgraded during a two-year production shutdown to make "Super Duty" pickup trucks, a massive boost for a Canadian auto sector starting to buckle under the weight of Trump's tariffs.
